rules.lossRule: close if spread debit reaches 2x the credit received or short strike is breached
rules.earningsRule: expiry must be before the next earnings date
rules.goalRealistic: 3-8% per month at 8-13% risk per trade; a single max-loss trade costs 8-13%, so two losers in a row is a 20%+ drawdown
rules.tslaBias: User bearish on TSLA through Oct 2026 (stated 9/14). No TSLA put credit spreads or any bullish TSLA exposure. TSLA call credit spreads only, sold into strength (up >=1.5% day or RSI >=60), $10 wide, expiry before Oct 21 earnings.
rules.timingCheck: Added 9/15: before alerting, read the dashboard's projected next turn for the ticker (data.js outlook/nextReversal). If a lower low (for puts) or higher high (for calls) is projected within 2 trading days, alert with a resting GTC limit above the current mid and check the short strike keeps a 6% cushion below the projected low; else name the next-lower spread. Record projectedTurn/projectedDate on the alert for later grading.

alerts.purpose: Every setup pushed to the user, whether or not it was traded, so alert quality can be graded at expiry (would-have outcome at max profit / max loss / partial).
alerts.gradeRule: At expiry, mark outcome: 'expiredWorthless' (full credit kept), 'breached' (short strike crossed at expiry), or 'partial'; record underlying close and what the spread would have paid at the 50% profit target.
